title: More charge through a wire
hook: Change current and predict charge transferred.
misconception: charge transferred stays fixed when current doubles.
objective: Apply Q = It to compare charge transferred when current changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a steady one-direction current over a fixed duration, Q = It. When current doubles, charge transferred becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model Q = It; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a steady one-direction current over a fixed duration, with a nonzero initial result. If current triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on charge transferred?
recall.why: Apply Q = It under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
